is_excellent.description: Indicates whether the service provider has a record of excellence (false for no record, true for having a record).

is_package.description: Indicates whether the job is a packaged offer (false for individual services, true for a package).

is_subscription.description: Indicates whether the job is subscription-based (false for one-time services, true for subscription).

I’m happy to help you find a place to eat on March 19 2024 at 12:00 pm!  
Since I don’t have a dedicated “restaurant‑search” function in this environment, I’ll need a bit more information so I can give you the best recommendations:

| What I need | Why it matters |
|-------------|----------------|
| **Location** (city, neighborhood, or address) | Restaurants vary by area; I’ll focus on places that are actually open on that date. |
| **Cuisine or type of food** (e.g., Thai, Italian, vegan, fast‑food) | Helps narrow down the list to your taste. |
| **Budget** (cheap, mid‑range, upscale) | Ensures the suggestions fit your spending plan. |
| **Special requirements** (e.g., pet‑friendly, wheelchair accessible, outdoor seating) | Makes sure the venue meets any extra needs. |
| **Number of people** | Some restaurants have limited seating or require reservations for larger groups. |

Once I have those details, I can:

1. **Check opening hours** – confirm that the restaurant is open on March 19 at noon.  
2. **Look for availability** – many places accept reservations online; I can point you to the booking page or give you a phone number.  
3. **Provide a short list** – with a brief description, address, contact info, and any special notes (e.g., “great for lunch crowds” or “offers a lunch special”).  

Feel free to share the above details, and I’ll get started right away!
